posts.title: GitHub App Authentication in Go: JWTs and Installation Tokens
posts.description: Build a GitHub App in Go that authenticates independently of users, mints short-lived installation tokens, and displays app, organization, and repository data.

posts.title: Build Passkey Authentication in Go: A Complete Workshop
posts.description: A step-by-step Go workshop: create a passkey, sign in, create a server session, and protect cookie-authenticated requests with a CSRF token.

posts.title: Shared Signals Framework: A Basic Transmitter in Go
posts.description: Learn what the Shared Signals Framework is, why security events matter, and how to build a small Go transmitter with signed SETs and a SQLite delivery queue.
